name: node-redis (redis)
solves: Provides the official Redis / Valkey client for Node.js (npm package `redis`) with modern Promise APIs, clustering, Sentinel, Lua scripting, Pub/Sub, streams, and first-class TypeScript types — suitable for shared caching and general Redis access.
best_for: Applications that want the official Redis Node client with broad command coverage
Caching, session stores, rate limiting, and Pub/Sub on Redis/Valkey
Teams that prefer the maintained `redis` package over older clients
Cluster and Sentinel deployments needing an official client path
TypeScript services that want typed Redis commands without ioredis
skip_when: You specifically need ioredis APIs/ecosystem middleware already in your codebase
You only need an in-process LRU and do not want Redis infrastructure
You want a multi-backend key-value abstraction (Keyv/unstorage) rather than Redis-specific APIs
You are on edge/serverless and prefer HTTP Redis (Upstash) over TCP clients
Your runtime cannot open persistent TCP connections to Redis

hosted_alternative.name: Upstash Redis
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Pay-per-request serverless Redis with a free tier; scales without connection pooling pain on edge
